request: Fix stale remaining-HP clash logs and unyielding death canceled by healing; identify gambling event; follow-up user request makes Leave resolve the event

fixes.rootCause: BuildClashPostLog captured current HP before PlayClashPresentation invoked the real impact callback.
fixes.change: Format the result only after presentation/impact returns, for ally/enemy attack wins and attack-vs-defense results. Shared normal and headless combat use this code.
fixes.proof: All four before-fix cases failed with the pre-hit HP; they pass after the ordering change.

fixes.rootCause: Heal cleared pendingCalamityDelayedDeath above 1HP, and round-start death also canceled itself when HP exceeded 1.
fixes.change: Once lethal protection triggers, keep the pending death regardless of subsequent healing; consume it once at next round start. Nonlethal healing is unchanged.
fixes.proof: Actual round-end healing by 2 and by 20 used to leave the enemy alive at 3HP or full HP; both now die at next round start. Zero-heal and nonlethal controls also pass.

fixes.rootEvent: Assets/Data/Events/025 旧赌桌/025 旧赌桌.asset
fixes.followUpAsset: Assets/Data/Events/025 旧赌桌/025-1 大赌之后.asset
fixes.rootCause: Follow-up Leave has no nextEvent but resolveEvent=false; shared MapEventOptionService therefore retains the unresolved tile and original event.
fixes.change: Set only follow-up Leave option (optionId=1) resolveEvent to true. Mark tile resolved, clear assignedEvent, count completion once; returning to the tile no longer opens the event.
fixes.proof: New actual-asset integration test failed on unresolved tile before the configuration change, then passed including leave-and-return movement.
